lines.t: God speak low but it shake everything
Still voice cut like a blade, let it ring
Hidden hearts get exposed in the light
Every soul get weighed, wrong or right
Pride like a veil keep it locked on tight
Cover they eyes, can’t see what’s right
Truth stand firm, never move, never fold
But the humble get covered in mercy untold
He resist what’s high, bring it down to the dust
Every idol fall when it’s placed over trust
He look to the low, to the broken, the least
That’s where grace flow heavy, that’s where peace
Not by might, not power, not show
But the ones who bow down, them the ones He know
When the heart come clean and the will let go
That’s the place where the living waters flow
Day come dark for the ones who refuse
Hear the call but still choose what they choose
Silence speak when the truth been ignored
Every word still stand from the Lord
Veil stay thick on the arrogant mind
Chasin’ self while they leavin’ truth behind
But the path of the humble shine bright
Crowned in glory, covered in light
God draw near when the heart come down
Not the loud, not the lifted, not the crowned
But the quiet, the broken, the ones made new
That’s the remnant walking in what is true
Grace ain’t earned, never bought, never sold
Given free but received by the low
Every knee gonna bend, every voice confess
But the humble right now get the covering rest
